claim: Merchant wants to automate WhatsApp order confirmations but finds no native Shopify feature
paraphrased_evidence: A merchant posted asking how to send automatic WhatsApp order confirmations to customers. They currently copy order details and send messages manually from their phone. They want a built-in solution or app that works reliably without manual work.

claim: Merchant manually verifies COD orders via WhatsApp to reduce fake orders
paraphrased_evidence: A merchant described that they receive many fake COD orders. Their current workaround is to manually message each customer on WhatsApp to confirm the order before shipping. This takes significant time and delays fulfillment.

claim: Merchant manually sends abandoned cart reminders via WhatsApp because Shopify email recovery has low open rates
paraphrased_evidence: A merchant explained that email-based abandoned cart recovery has low open rates in their region. They manually copy phone numbers from Shopify and send WhatsApp messages to remind customers. They want an automated WhatsApp recovery flow.

claim: Merchant struggles with WhatsApp template approval delays and rejections
paraphrased_evidence: A merchant reported that their WhatsApp message templates keep getting rejected by Meta, causing delays in launching automated notifications. They have to rework templates multiple times and wait days for each review. Some merchants also reported their personal WhatsApp numbers getting banned when using unofficial methods.

claim: Merchant receives duplicate WhatsApp notifications from multiple Shopify apps
paraphrased_evidence: A merchant complained that customers receive two WhatsApp messages for the same order event because they use two different apps for order notifications and marketing. They cannot easily deduplicate and have to manually disable features in one app.

claim: Merchant finds WhatsApp integration apps too expensive for small store
paraphrased_evidence: A small merchant posted that most WhatsApp apps on Shopify cost $15–$50/month, which is too high for their low-volume store. They are looking for a free or cheaper alternative but find none that cover all their needs (notifications, marketing, support).

claim: Merchant manually exports customer phone numbers from Shopify for WhatsApp broadcasts
paraphrased_evidence: A merchant asked how to export customer phone numbers from Shopify to use in WhatsApp marketing. They currently export a CSV, copy numbers, and upload to a broadcast tool. They want a direct integration to avoid manual steps.

claim: Merchant struggles to manage customer support across WhatsApp and Shopify Inbox
paraphrased_evidence: A merchant described that customers often message them on WhatsApp instead of using Shopify Inbox. They have to switch between apps, copy conversation histories, and sometimes miss messages. They wish there was a unified inbox.
